rationale: B0 requires an immutable DEV/HELD_OUT split and reports class-sensitive metrics rather than a scalar score.
A pre-split role with fewer than two scoreable materials cannot place at least one independent material in both DEV and HELD_OUT.
The current B2 truth-bundle catalog has two scoreable POSITIVE materials, two scoreable NEGATIVE materials, and two scoreable BORDERLINE materials.
The minimum role-count split-feasibility rule is therefore satisfied; this does not by itself establish benchmark qualification or statistical precision.
interpretation_constraints: This B2 rule is a minimum split-feasibility requirement, not a B6 qualification threshold.
No sensitivity, specificity, or power claim is authorized from the current scoreable counts.
Bootstrap or repeated trajectories do not create independent benchmark materials.
